description.p: Belfry is a podcast client for GNOME that combines Overcast's audio engine (Smart Speed silence-skipping, Voice Boost compression and EQ) with Castro's Inbox to Queue triage model on top of a filesystem-canonical library.

Per-show overrides for everything that affects playback. Streaming and background download. Bulk-action subscription management at scale. MPRIS2 integration for the GNOME media overlay and Bluetooth headset buttons. Local-first: no telemetry, no cloud, no recommendations.

Phase 1 — SQLite spine. Single-writer worker, read-only connection pool, full domain CRUD (shows, episodes, playback, show_settings, listening_sessions, chapters, tags), schema migration runner, fixture generator (100 / 1K / 10K / 50K episodes via belfry --fixture). FTS5 triggers verified end-to-end. 65 tests pass; cold-start perf gate landed 1.5 ms vs the 250 ms budget. No UI integration yet.

Phase 0 scaffolding. Cargo workspace stood up with four crates (belfry-core, belfry-search, belfry-cli, belfry). Build infrastructure, CI, GSettings schema, AppStream metainfo, and Flatpak manifest skeleton in place. No application logic yet.
